# Sound Data Processing
## Stack Logged Spectra and Logged BB, seperately
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(data.table)

# Set the working directory to the STA497 folder
setwd("./Raw")

# Get a list of all LNM folders
folders <- list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize empty lists to store data for the different types of files
logged_spectra_list <- list()
# total_spectra_list <- list()
logged_bb_list <- list()
# total_bb_list <- list()
# logged_ln_list <- list()
# total_ln_list <- list()

# Initialize vectors to keep track of missing or empty files
missing_logged_spectra <- c()
# missing_total_spectra <- c()
missing_logged_bb <- c()
# missing_total_bb <- c()
# missing_logged_ln <- c()
# missing_total_ln <- c()

empty_logged_spectra <- c()
# empty_total_spectra <- c()
empty_logged_bb <- c()
# empty_total_bb <- c()
# empty_logged_ln <- c()
# empty_total_ln <- c()

# Iterate through all folders
for (folder in folders) {
  # Extract folder name
  folder_name <- basename(folder)
  
  # Construct file paths for Logged and Total files
  logged_spectra_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedSpectra.txt"))
  # total_spectra_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalSpectra.txt"))
  
  logged_bb_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedBB.txt"))
  # total_bb_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalBB.txt"))
  
  # logged_ln_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedLN.txt"))
  # total_ln_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalLN.txt"))
  
  # Check and read LoggedSpectra files
  if (file.exists(logged_spectra_file) && file.size(logged_spectra_file) > 0) {
    logged_spectra_data <- fread(logged_spectra_file, fill = TRUE)
    logged_spectra_list[[length(logged_spectra_list) + 1]] <- logged_spectra_data
  } else if (file.exists(logged_spectra_file) && file.size(logged_spectra_file) == 0) {
    empty_logged_spectra <- c(empty_logged_spectra, folder_name)
  } else {
    missing_logged_spectra <- c(missing_logged_spectra, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read TotalSpectra files
  # if (file.exists(total_spectra_file)) {
  #   if (file.size(total_spectra_file) > 0) {
  #     total_spectra_data <- fread(total_spectra_file, fill = TRUE)
  #     total_spectra_list[[length(total_spectra_list) + 1]] <- total_spectra_data
  #   } else {
  #     empty_total_spectra <- c(empty_total_spectra, folder_name)
  #   }
  # } else {
  #   missing_total_spectra <- c(missing_total_spectra, folder_name)
  #}
  
  # Check and read LoggedBB files
  if (file.exists(logged_bb_file) && file.size(logged_bb_file) > 0) {
    logged_bb_data <- fread(logged_bb_file, fill = TRUE)
    logged_bb_list[[length(logged_bb_list) + 1]] <- logged_bb_data
  } else if (file.exists(logged_bb_file) && file.size(logged_bb_file) == 0) {
    empty_logged_bb <- c(empty_logged_bb, folder_name)
  } else {
    missing_logged_bb <- c(missing_logged_bb, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read TotalBB files
  # if (file.exists(total_bb_file)) {
  #   if (file.size(total_bb_file) > 0) {
  #     total_bb_data <- fread(total_bb_file, fill = TRUE)
  #     total_bb_list[[length(total_bb_list) + 1]] <- total_bb_data
  #   } else {
  #     empty_total_bb <- c(empty_total_bb, folder_name)
  #   }
  # } else {
  #   missing_total_bb <- c(missing_total_bb, folder_name)
  # }
  
  # Check and read LoggedLN files
  # if (file.exists(logged_ln_file) && file.size(logged_ln_file) > 0) {
  #   logged_ln_data <- fread(logged_ln_file, fill = TRUE)
  #   logged_ln_list[[length(logged_ln_list) + 1]] <- logged_ln_data
  # } else if (file.exists(logged_ln_file) && file.size(logged_ln_file) == 0) {
  #   empty_logged_ln <- c(empty_logged_ln, folder_name)
  # } else {
  #   missing_logged_ln <- c(missing_logged_ln, folder_name)
  # }
  
  # Check and read TotalLN files
  # if (file.exists(total_ln_file)) {
  #   if (file.size(total_ln_file) > 0) {
  #     total_ln_data <- fread(total_ln_file, fill = TRUE)
  #     total_ln_list[[length(total_ln_list) + 1]] <- total_ln_data
  #   } else {
  #     empty_total_ln <- c(empty_total_ln, folder_name)
  #   }
  # } else {
  #   missing_total_ln <- c(missing_total_ln, folder_name)
  # }
}

# Stack all the data for each group
if (length(logged_spectra_list) > 0) {
  logged_spectra_combined <- rbindlist(logged_spectra_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(logged_spectra_combined, file = "../008_097_logged_spectra.rdata")
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Step 1: Rename columns to remove spaces
logged_spectra_combined <- logged_spectra_combined %>%
  rename(Project_Name = `Project Name`, Start_Time = `Start Time`)

logged_bb_combined <- logged_bb_combined %>%
  rename(Project_Name = `Project Name`, Start_Time = `Start Time`)
```

```{r}
logged_bb_combined$Start_Time <- as.POSIXct(logged_bb_combined$Start_Time, format = "%m/%d/%Y %I:%M:%S %p")
```

#### 23 rows missing Project Name & Time in Logged BB

```{r}
dim(missing_rows_bb)
```

#### 23 rows missing Project Name & Time in Logged Spectra
```{r}

dim(missing_rows_spectra)
```
### Drop NA rows of Project Name or Time in both datasets
```{r}
# Drop rows where Project_Name or Start_Time are NA
logged_bb_combined <- logged_bb_combined[!is.na(logged_bb_combined$Project_Name) & !is.na(logged_bb_combined$Start_Time), ]

# Check the dimensions to confirm it has the correct number of rows
dim(logged_bb_combined)

```

```{r}
# Drop rows where Project_Name or Start_Time are NA
logged_spectra_combined <- logged_spectra_combined[!is.na(logged_spectra_combined$Project_Name) & !is.na(logged_spectra_combined$Start_Time), ]

# Check the dimensions to confirm it has the correct number of rows
dim(logged_spectra_combined)
```

```{r}
# Remove leading/trailing spaces
logged_spectra_combined$Project_Name <- trimws(logged_spectra_combined$Project_Name)
logged_bb_combined$Project_Name <- trimws(logged_bb_combined$Project_Name)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
sound_merged_data <- merge(logged_spectra_combined, logged_bb_combined, 
                         by = c("Project_Name", "Start_Time"))
```

## Operation on Data: chr to numeric, NA values removal

```{r}
head(nox_data)
dim(nox_data)
```
### chr to numeric
```{r}
nox_data$nox <- as.numeric(nox_data$nox)
nox_data$no <- as.numeric(nox_data$no)
nox_data$no2 <- as.numeric(nox_data$no2)

```
### Nox data started from 2023-04-15 00:00, while nox & no & no2 are missing until 2023-04-15 19:25
```{r}
# Find the index of the first non-missing value in the nox column
first_non_missing_index <- which(!is.na(nox_data$nox))[1]

# Subset the dataset from the first non-missing row
nox_data_reduced <- nox_data[first_non_missing_index:nrow(nox_data), ]

# Check the result
head(nox_data_reduced)
```
### convert time
```{r}
# Convert the time_utc column to POSIXct format
nox_data_reduced$time_utc <- as.POSIXct(nox_data_reduced$time_utc, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")

# Check the result
head(nox_data_reduced$time_utc)
```

```{r}
earliest_time_nox <- min(nox_data_reduced$time_utc, na.rm = TRUE)
earliest_time_nox
```

```{r}
earliest_time_sound
```

# Correlation Plot
```{r}
# Define the variables of interest
variables_of_interest <- c(
  "LAFmax", "LAFmin", "LCpeak", "LAeq", "LAleq", "LCeq", "LZeq 12.5Hz", 
  "LZeq 16Hz", "LZeq 20Hz", "LZeq 25Hz", "LZeq 31.5Hz", "LZeq 40Hz", 
  "LZeq 50Hz", "LZeq 63Hz", "LZeq 80Hz", "LZeq 100Hz", "LZeq 125Hz", 
  "LZeq 160Hz", "LZeq 200Hz", "LZeq 250Hz", "LZeq 315Hz", "LZeq 400Hz", 
  "LZeq 500Hz", "LZeq 630Hz", "LZeq 800Hz", "LZeq 1kHz", "LZeq 1.25kHz", 
  "LZeq 1.6kHz", "LZeq 2kHz", "LZeq 2.5kHz", "LZeq 3.15kHz", "LZeq 4kHz", 
  "LZeq 5kHz", "LZeq 6.3kHz", "LZeq 8kHz", "LZeq 10kHz", "LZeq 12.5kHz", 
  "LZeq 16kHz", "Sample temp (C)", "Sample RH (%)", "Sample dewpoint (C)", 
  "Internal pressure (Pa)", "Internal temp (C)", "Ambient Temperature", 
  "Wind speed", "Wind direction", "PM2.5(mg/m3)", "BC(ng/m3)", "no2"
)

# Check which variables are missing from the dataframe
missing_variables <- variables_of_interest[!variables_of_interest %in% colnames(sound_nox_data)]

# Print the missing variables
print(missing_variables)
```
```{r}
summary_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = variables_of_interest,
  Min = NA,
  First_Qu = NA,
  Median = NA,
  Mean = NA,
  Third_Qu = NA,
  Max = NA
)

# Step 5: For the variables that exist in the dataset, calculate the summary statistics
for (var in variables_of_interest) {
  if (var %in% colnames(sound_nox_data)) {
    summary_values <- summary(sound_nox_data[[var]])
    summary_data[summary_data$Variable == var, "Min"] <- summary_values["Min."]
    summary_data[summary_data$Variable == var, "First_Qu"] <- summary_values["1st Qu."]
    summary_data[summary_data$Variable == var, "Median"] <- summary_values["Median"]
    summary_data[summary_data$Variable == var, "Mean"] <- summary_values["Mean"]
    summary_data[summary_data$Variable == var, "Third_Qu"] <- summary_values["3rd Qu."]
    summary_data[summary_data$Variable == var, "Max"] <- summary_values["Max."]
  }
}

# Step 6: Rename columns to fix the issue
colnames(summary_data) <- c("Variable", "Min", "1st Qu", "Median", "Mean", "3rd Qu", "Max")

# Step 7: Print the summary table using kable
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

kable(summary_data, format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = F)
```
```{r}
# install.packages("corrplot")
# install.packages("Hmisc")

library(ggcorrplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)

```

```{r}
correlation_variables <- c(
  "LAFmax", "LAFmin", "LCpeak", "LCeq", 
  "LZeq 40Hz", "LZeq 63Hz", "LZeq 80Hz", "LZeq 100Hz", 
  "LZeq 125Hz", "LZeq 160Hz", "LZeq 250Hz", "LZeq 500Hz", 
  "LZeq 800Hz", "LZeq 5kHz", "LZeq 12.5kHz", "no2"
)

# Step 2: Filter the dataset to include only the variables for correlation
filtered_data <- sound_nox_data[, correlation_variables, drop=FALSE]
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Compute the correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- rcorr(as.matrix(filtered_data))$r  # This will calculate the Pearson correlation matrix

# Step 2: Plot the correlation matrix using corrplot with the 'circle' method
corrplot(cor_matrix, 
         method = "circle",         # Plot method
         type = "lower",            # Show only upper triangle
         col = colorRampPalette(c("brown", "white", "purple"))(200),  # Custom color palette
         tl.col = "black",          # Color of the text labels
         tl.cex = 0.8,              # Size of text labels
         tl.srt = 45,
         cl.cex = 0.8,              # Size of color legend text
         addgrid.col = "grey",        
         is.corr = TRUE)            # Indicate that it is a correlation matrix

```

### chr to numeric

### Nox data started from 2023-04-15 00:00, while nox & no & no2 are missing until 2023-04-15 19:25
```{r}
# Find the index of the first non-missing value in the nox column
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("flare_well_sound_pollutant_met_data.csv")
```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

# Ensure df is a data.table
setDT(df)

# Check column names
print(colnames(df))

# Convert time_utc to POSIXct format if needed
df[, time_utc := as.POSIXct(time_utc, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz="UTC")]

# Filter data for September 2023
df_sep_2023 <- df[time_utc >= "2023-09-05 11:11" & time_utc < "2023-09-05 11:20"]

# Plot time series of LZeq.12.5Hz in September 2023
ggplot(df_sep_2023, aes(x = time_utc, y = LZeq.12.5Hz)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Time Series of LZeq.12.5Hz (September 2023)", 
       x = "Time", y = "LZeq 12.5Hz (dB)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))




```
